boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Missouri-Columbia
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe Columbia food and coffee destinations with late service or delivery.

cards.title: Bite
cards.subtitle: 2900 Trimble Road, Suite 105, Columbia
cards.notes: Use the listed Friday–Saturday After Bite window when you need a late food option; confirm the night’s availability before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Friday-and-Saturday late-food option with an official After Bite service window.
cards.evidence_claim: Bite lists After Bite hours of Friday–Saturday, 8:00 p.m.–2:30 a.m., at 2900 Trimble Road in Columbia.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists After Bite service Friday–Saturday from 8:00 p.m. to 2:30 a.m.

cards.title: Pickleman's Downtown Columbia
cards.subtitle: 1106 East Broadway, downtown Columbia
cards.notes: Plan for sandwiches, salads, pizzas, or soups from the East Broadway location; its official page lists service through 2 a.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Pickleman’s location with daily 2 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickleman’s lists its Downtown Columbia cafe at 1106 East Broadway as open 10 a.m.–2 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists hours of 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: Pickleman's Old 63
cards.subtitle: 2513 Old 63 South, Columbia
cards.notes: Use this distinct Pickleman’s location when south Columbia is more convenient; the official listing shows late daily service until 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: The original Pickleman’s location, with daily 2 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickleman’s lists its Old 63 cafe at 2513 Old 63 South as open 10 a.m.–2 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists hours of 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: Southside Pizza & Pub
cards.subtitle: Columbia delivery service
cards.notes: Place a delivery order rather than relying on dine-in: the business’s contact page specifically states late-night Columbia delivery until 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Columbia delivery option documented to run until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Southside Pizza & Pub states that it offers delivery to Columbia, Missouri, until 2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official contact page states late-night delivery to Columbia until 2:00 a.m.; listed business hours end at midnight.

cards.title: The Grind South
cards.subtitle: 4603 John Garry Drive, Columbia
cards.notes: Bring work or a book to the coffee shop’s seating areas, then use the posted midnight or 1 a.m. closing times as your late cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A coffeehouse with seating and late closing on most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grind South lists Monday–Thursday hours until midnight and Friday–Saturday hours until 1:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Mon–Thu 5:30 a.m.–midnight, Fri 5:30 a.m.–1 a.m., Sat 6:30 a.m.–1 a.m., and Sun until 11 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Providence
cards.subtitle: 411 South Providence Road, Columbia
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the documented late option; the official location page lists it through 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A South Providence drive-thru listed through 3 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 411 South Providence Road drive-thru in Columbia as open 9:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are separately listed.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Nifong
cards.subtitle: 508 East Nifong Boulevard, Columbia
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: the official listing shows drive-thru service to 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An East Nifong drive-thru with 2–3 a.m. posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 508 East Nifong Boulevard drive-thru until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and until 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru closing at 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Business Loop 70
cards.subtitle: 220 Business Loop 70 East, Columbia
cards.notes: For the latest listed drive-thru window, use the Business Loop location; its official hours page shows service through 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Business Loop drive-thru with a daily 3 a.m. listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 220 Business Loop 70 East drive-thru in Columbia as open 9:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are separately listed.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Cinnamon Hill Lane
cards.subtitle: 1421 Cinnamon Hill Lane, Columbia
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late option near Cinnamon Hill; posted closing varies from 2 a.m. to 3 a.m. by day.
cards.short_summary: A Cinnamon Hill drive-thru with 2–3 a.m. posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1421 Cinnamon Hill Lane drive-thru until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru closing at 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Papa Johns on East Broadway
cards.subtitle: 1205 East Broadway, Columbia
cards.notes: Order delivery or carryout from the East Broadway store; its official locator lists later Friday–Saturday hours than the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: An East Broadway pizza option with late delivery and carryout listings.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery at 1205 East Broadway until 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday and carryout until 1:40 a.m. those nights.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists delivery until 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday and carryout until 1:40 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
